sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: datasheet); size 70 x 70 x 201 mm (w x d x h); port and control positions are placeholders until measured

Neumann M 149 Tube set page and N 149 A page (read by a research pass 2026-11-12): the microphone has a DIN-8 connector to the power supply and the N 149 A supply has the XLR-3 male output (the set page says XLR-3 F for the supply, probably the matching cable plug). The Bêta proposal port (xlr3-m mic output) is kept and modelled on the base of the microphone as a stand-in: the real XLR is on the N 149 A, not on the microphone. The lathe profile is an estimate from the outer size (70 x 70 x 201 mm, datasheet, size ok): body, neck and a 70 mm head basket, no photo or drawing opened. Beta-modelled. Generic artwork only (content/generic-panels/<id>.json, drawn by npm run asset:panel): connectors, knobs and indicators drawn at the port positions, no photo, no logo, no lettering. Every port and control position is a guess (confidence guess): no drawing or photo was opened.
